failed_checks.check_name: Containers should not run with allowPrivilegeEscalation
code_block:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: DaemonSet
metadata:
  name: sysconf-agent
  labels:
    app: sysconf-agent
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: sysconf-agent
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: sysconf-agent
    spec:
      hostPID: true
      containers:
        - name: agent
          image: example/sysconf-agent:1.0
          securityContext:
            runAsUser: 0
            capabilities:
              add: ["SYS_ADMIN", "SYS_PTRACE", "NET_ADMIN"]
          volumeMounts:
            - name: etc
              mountPath: /host/etc
          command: ["/agent", "--manage-host"]
      volumes:
        - name: etc
          hostPath:
            path: /etc
